toolchain.binaries: llama-b12282-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip (25,058,018 B) via ghproxy.net mirror (github.com direct is blocked in this sandbox)
toolchain.source_tarball: api.github.com/repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/tarball/b12282 -> codeload (38,847,254 B), used for convert_hf_to_gguf.py + conversion/ + gguf-py
toolchain.gguf_python: repo-matched gguf-py from the same tarball (PyPI gguf 0.19.0 is incompatible with b12282's GGUFWriter API: tensor_filter)

conversion.text_architecture: llama (text-only export; SmolVLM vision tensors are skipped in the text path)
conversion.mmproj_architecture: clip / GGUFType.MMPROJ (SmolVLM vision tower 198 tensors, VisionProjectorType.IDEFICS3)

text.note: 181 of 273 tensors required fallback quantization (small tensors kept at higher precision), so effective BPW is 6.05 not 4.5

synthetic_50.protocol: llama.cpp llama-mtmd-cli, p1 frozen prompt, greedy (--temp 0, -n 48), one image per process
synthetic_50.scope_red_line: DIAGNOSTIC subset run, not the official 1,000-image evaluation with validation report. Must not be written into Table 1 as an official metric; it only proves the quantized GGUF is loadable and produces parseable boxes on real images.

refcoco_20.protocol: llama.cpp llama-mtmd-cli, p1 frozen prompt, greedy (--temp 0, -n 48), one image per process
refcoco_20.scope_red_line: DIAGNOSTIC subset run, not the official 1,000-image evaluation with validation report. Must not be written into Table 1 as an official metric; it only proves the quantized GGUF is loadable and produces parseable boxes on real images.

official_eval.reason: A server-mode runner was implemented (src/eval/run_zeroshot_gguf.py, llama-server /v1/chat/completions, -np parallel slots, per-slot context fix) and a per-image CLI path was benchmarked, but CPU throughput is the wall: llama-mtmd-cli needs 5.6-5.8 s/image effective with 8 parallel processes (and llama-server serialises the mtmd image encode, giving 11.4 s/image), i.e. 2,000 images would take 3+ hours. The remaining window before 15:30 did not allow an official 1,000-image x 2-dataset run, so Table 1's +4-bit row stays `not_run` and only the 100-image diagnostics are cited.

scope_red_line: Diagnostics used llama-mtmd-cli with -n 48 and one process per image; RefCOCO parse 0.65 is partly a -n 48 truncation artifact, so its mIoU is diagnostic only.
GGUF + mmproj is a real deployable artifact (loads and grounds), but accuracy must be quoted only as the diagnostic numbers above, never as Table 1.
BPW of the text model is 6.05 (Q4_K_M with fallback tensors), not 4.0 — do not describe it as a uniform 4-bit model.

diagnostics_100.protocol: llama-mtmd-cli.exe, one process per image, 8 parallel, frozen p1 prompt, greedy (--temp 0, -n 48)
diagnostics_100.cross_check: CPU merged fp32 official 1,000-image run was acc@0.5 0.017 / mIoU 0.083760 (synthetic); this Q4_K_M 100-image diagnostic is 0.01 / 0.069935 — same order, but different n/backend so NOT comparable as an official delta.
diagnostics_100.refcoco_parse_caveat: RefCOCO parse 0.53 is dominated by -n 48 truncation (long generations on some images); it is an artifact of the diagnostic budget, not evidence about model quality.
